build_minicheetah_sim: build a pybullet simulation of the MiniCheetah quadruped robot using the MiniCheetah class
create_minicheetah_instance: create a MiniCheetah instance with custom motor_kp and motor_kd PID control parameters
load_urdf_model: load the mini_cheetah URDF robot model into the pybullet physics client
reset_robot_pose: reset all 12 motor joints to their initial angles using ResetPose
settle_robot_for_reset: settle the MiniCheetah robot into a stable pose using position control before reset
